topic: Octopus arms can think for themselves
script: About two thirds of an octopus's neurons are in its arms, not its brain. Its suckers can taste things just by touching them. An arm can keep reacting to touch even after it has been cut off. Octopuses can change color and skin texture in a fraction of a second. Strangely, scientists think most octopuses are colorblind. Follow Pixel Abyss for more strange facts from the deep.
